title: VoxAI — Put your AI in every conversation
excerpt: VoxAI is a local-first recording, transcription, and live AI copilot for macOS. It labels speakers, gives your AI the live conversation, and turns talk into advice, notes, and action items.
content_html:
Local transcription + live AI copilot for macOS

VoxAI records locally, transcribes, and labels every speaker — then gives the live conversation to the AI you already use. Get advice while you talk, then turn the full record into notes and action items.

  • No account
  • No card for the trial
  • Recordings stay on your Mac

AI connected · listening live

01

Transcribe as you talk

Live speaker labels mean no replaying the whole recording later.

02

Get advice in time

Questions, risks, and next steps arrive while they still matter.

03

Leave with the work done

Hand the complete record to your AI for notes, actions, and follow-up.

More than a recorder

The conversation is still going. The result is already forming.

VoxAI keeps one accurate record for you and one live stream for your AI. You stay in the conversation; the details keep organizing themselves.

LIVE · SPEAKER LABELED

01

Every line has a name

Meetings and in-person conversations get live speaker labels. Calls separate your mic and system audio, so identity comes from the channel — not a guess.

02

Your AI is actually present

It follows the growing transcript and can push fact checks, questions, risks, strategy, and action items into the side panel.

03

The record keeps working

Export clean Markdown, ask for a recap, draft the follow-up, or return to any conversation later. Your archive remains yours.

Four conversation modes

Pick a scene. Start talking.

MEET

Meeting

Multiple speakers, live names, and AI notes that grow with the room.

CALL

Call

You and the other side on separate channels, with labels that never need guessing.

1:1

In-Person

Negotiations, interviews, and one-on-ones with advice tuned to the moment.

VOICE

Voice Chat

Speak to your AI from across the room and hear the answer out loud.

Three steps to start

Set it up once. Then forget the setup.

No extension, Python environment, or API-key maze. VoxAI ships as one notarized Mac app and gives your AI the exact connection prompt.

  1. 01

    Drag to Applications

    Open the notarized .dmg and move VoxAI across. Installation is done.

  2. 02

    Paste one message to your AI

    Copy the prompt from VoxAI. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another MCP client connects itself.

  3. 03

    Choose a scene

    Your AI checks in by name. Start the conversation and let VoxAI handle the record.

Three steps. There is no fourth step.

Local by default

Your conversation stays on your Mac.

Recording, transcription, speaker labels, and the flagship local voice can all run on-device. VoxAI does not require an account, and cloud options stay off until you explicitly turn them on.

●

Local recording and transcription

The raw conversation does not need to leave your computer.

●

Cloud is always opt-in

Every upload path sits behind a clear switch and notice.

●

Your archive stays yours

View and export every old recording forever, whether you buy or not.

No account · local MCP over stdio · no open network port

Try the whole product first

Ten sessions free. Then buy it once.

The trial is the real app, not a stripped-down demo. No account, no card, and no locked features.

MAC APP STORE

Free to download

US$0

The first ten sessions are the complete app. Unlock inside the app for US$19.99.

  • Full transcription and speaker labels
  • Live AI copilot included
  • Only real recordings of 60 seconds or more count
Get it on the Mac App Store

DIRECT DOWNLOAD · REGULAR US$39

Keep VoxAI forever

US$19.90

For the .dmg version. One payment, key by email, activated locally — a separate line from the App Store purchase.

  • Unlimited recordings + live copilot
  • One permanent license for two Macs
  • Free updates through 1.x
Buy once · US$19.90

Notarized Developer ID · macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon

What happens after the ten free recordings?

VoxAI degrades gently: your history remains fully viewable and exportable, new recordings cap at ten minutes, and live copilot advice pauses until you unlock.

How do I unlock?

Two independent lines. From the Mac App Store, you unlock inside the app and can restore it on any Mac signed in to the same Apple Account. From the .dmg, a key reaches your payment email; paste it into VoxAI and local verification unlocks it permanently. A key from one line does not activate the other.

Which AI clients work?

Any MCP client can browse and summarize the archive. Agentic clients that can keep a live loop — including Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor — can act as the real-time copilot.

Does the price renew?

No. It is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

For people who want the protocol

Connect the AI you already have. Do not adopt another chatbot.

VoxAI includes a local MCP server. A new client reads the protocol instructions as soon as it connects, so the archive and live copilot behavior travel with the product.

Archive

NeedsAny MCP client

GetsBrowse, rename, summarize, export, and speak recordings

GetsListen live, push advice, and hold a voice-direct dialog

READY WHEN YOU ARE

Bring your AI into the next conversation.

content_html_zh:
适用于 macOS 的本地转录 + 实时 AI 副驾驶

VoxAI 在本地记录、转录并标记每个发言者 - 然后将实时对话提供给您已经使用的人工智能。 在谈话时获取建议，然后将完整记录转化为笔记和行动项目。

  • 没有账户
  • 没有试用卡
  • 录音保留在您的 Mac 上

AI互联·现场聆听

01

一边说话一边转录

现场演讲者标签意味着以后不再重播整个录音。

02

及时获得建议

问题、风险和后续步骤在它们仍然重要的时候就出现了。

03

完成工作后离开

将完整记录交给人工智能以进行注释、操作和后续操作。

不仅仅是录音机

谈话仍在继续。 结果已经形成。

VoxAI 为您保留一份准确记录，并为您的 AI 保留一份直播。 你留在谈话中；细节不断组织起来。

现场·演讲者标签

01

每行都有一个名字

会议和面对面的对话会获得现场演讲者标签。 呼叫将您的麦克风和系统音频分开，因此身份来自频道，而不是猜测。

02

你的人工智能确实存在

它遵循不断增长的记录，可以将事实检查、问题、风险、策略和行动项目推送到侧面板中。

03

记录继续工作

导出干净的 Markdown、要求重述、起草后续内容或稍后返回任何对话。 您的档案仍然属于您。

四种对话模式

选择一个场景。 开始说话。

MEET

会议

多位发言者、真实姓名和人工智能笔记随着房间的发展而增长。

CALL

Call

你和另一方在不同的频道上，带有永远不需要猜测的标签。

1:1

面对面

谈判、采访和一对一的咨询，提供适合当前情况的建议。

VOICE

语音聊天

从房间的另一边与你的人工智能交谈并大声听到答案。

三个步骤开始

设置一次就可以了。 然后忘记设置。

没有扩展、Python 环境或 API 密钥迷宫。 VoxAI 作为一款经过公证的 Mac 应用程序提供，并为您的 AI 提供准确的连接提示。

  1. 01拖至应用程序打开经过公证的 .dmg 并移动 VoxAI。 安装完成。
  2. 02将一条消息粘贴到您的 AI 从 VoxAI 复制提示。 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或其他 MCP 客户端会自行连接。
  3. 03选择一个场景你的人工智能会按名字登记。 开始对话并让 VoxAI 处理记录。

三步。 没有第四步。
